column1: # Inventory generated with the SYSTEM exokit (`~/.local/bin/exokit extract
# exodoc/src`), then narrowed to the deterministic, side-effect-free surface.
# The C runner #includes the REAL exodoc source (audit.c, which holds all four
# curated functions) and stubs the util.c helpers that other audit.c functions
# reference — the curated functions never call them, so this is genuine
# anti-drift coverage of exodoc's validation logic in the next version.
# NOTE: word_char was previously duplicated in both util.c and audit.c; it is
# now a single static inline in exodoc.h (fixed during next-version dev). The
# runner includes audit.c, which picks up the shared definition.
